name: NSE India stocks
description: Market data for stocks listed on the National Stock Exchange of India: symbol search, history and live quotes under NSE: symbols.

settings.label: Refresh (seconds)
settings.help: How often prices of open NSE charts and watchlist rows are refreshed. The minimum is 5 seconds.

setup: No account or key is needed. NSE: symbols appear in the symbol search as soon as the plugin is enabled.
